name: Feedback Button
description: Two identical thumb pills that morph into a single confirmation bar. Voting keeps the pressed pill mounted and stretches it — the thumb never blinks, it just slides left as the pill grows around it — while the other pill pops out of flow. A 'Feedback Received!' label drops in blurred, an Undo capsule slides in from the right edge, and a thumbs-up fires a deterministic confetti burst. Undo plays the whole thing in reverse.

variations.name: default
variations.previewHint: Click a thumb to vote — thumbs-up throws confetti — then hit Undo to reverse it
variations.description: A thumbs up/down pair that morphs into a confirmation bar via a single persistent node running `layout`, with an Undo capsule that plays the morph back in reverse on a faster, flat spring.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the root wrapper's classes for call-site layout overrides.

features: Morphs with `layout` on one persistent node rather than `layoutId` across two — the voted thumb is never unmounted, so it slides instead of blinking
Drops the losing pill with AnimatePresence mode="popLayout" so it leaves the flow on frame one and the survivor glides immediately
Splits the transition per property: physical values (x, y, scale) get a 0.28-bounce spring, opacity and blur ride a flat one so they can't overshoot past opaque
Asymmetric timing — voting is a deliberate 0.42s spring with bounce, undo snaps back flat in 0.3s, and content exits in 0.16s so no label outlives its pill
Fires a deterministic, seed-based confetti field on thumbs-up only — Math.random() would break hydration, and applauding a thumbs-down is the wrong feeling

Ships a themed palette as --fb-* cssVars with light and dark values, so the warm cream pill keeps its character at charcoal luminance instead of swapping to grey — the confetti's ink particle flips with it

featureSections.title: One-Node Pill Morph
featureSections.summary: The pressed pill is the same DOM node before and after the vote, so the morph is a size change rather than a swap between two elements.
points: Runs `layout` (not `layoutId`) on the pill, with only its *content* mounting and unmounting inside
Keeps border-radius as an inline pixel value so Motion can undo the corner distortion the layout scale introduces
Pins the thumb with layout="position" so it holds its true size while the pill's width animates
Filters the option list instead of hiding the loser, and lets popLayout pull it out of flow on the first frame

featureSections.title: Arriving Content
featureSections.summary: The label and the Undo capsule land as objects, entering from the edges they belong to rather than fading in place.
points: Drops "Feedback Received!" from above through a 4px blur on a 0.2-bounce spring — text wobbles read as glitches sooner than boxes do
Slides the Undo capsule in from the right edge it is anchored to, x: 16 → 0
Gives opacity and filter their own bounce-free springs so neither clamps into a visible hitch
Exits both on a 0.16s flat spring — half the arrival — so nothing is still fading outside a shrinking pill

featureSections.title: Confetti Burst
featureSections.summary: A hydration-safe particle field thrown from a zero-size origin at the pill's centre, positive votes only.
points: Seeds every particle from a sin-based `frac(index)` so server and client render identical fields
Fans the throw across the upper half only — particles leaving downward read as debris, not celebration
Splits x and y onto separate curves so gravity lives on y alone: the throw eases out while the drop eases in
Hangs off the non-animating wrapper, not the `layout` pill, so the burst isn't scaled and smeared by the morph

featureSections.title: Accessibility & Reduced Motion
featureSections.summary: The pill changes role with its state, and decorative motion is dropped rather than softened.
points: Idle the pill is role="button" with a label and Enter/Space handling; expanded it becomes role="status", because it then contains the Undo button and a button inside a button is invalid
Carries visible focus-visible rings on both the pill and the Undo capsule
Marks the confetti origin aria-hidden and skips mounting it entirely under prefers-reduced-motion
Wraps everything in MotionConfig reducedMotion="user" so the morph itself respects the OS setting
